name: Kirkuk

queries.query: site:moj.gov.iq مديرية التسجيل العقاري كركوك الأولى الثانية قاعدة بيانات الأراضي والمالكين
queries.scope: Confirm the city-local real-estate registry and determine whether a public parcel map/service exists.
queries.result: The Iraqi Ministry of Justice directory lists Real Estate Registration Directorates Kirkuk 1 and Kirkuk 2, plus nearby directorates. A July 2026 Ministry report says the director-general visited Kirkuk 1 and 2 and directed staff to begin preparing a land/property database for a housing initiative. This is evidence of an operating local registry and a database still being prepared, not a published public GIS.
queries.executionMethod: Official Ministry of Justice search and page inspection.

queries.query: Kirkuk Iraq official real estate registration directorate public cadastral map parcel service
queries.scope: Cross-check local registry offices and the availability of public parcel geometry.
queries.result: The official Ministry describes its electronic property-title/map application as initially launched at selected Baghdad directorates; Kirkuk is not among the listed offices. The available application is a request workflow, not an anonymous parcel geometry endpoint. No public full-polygon service or download was verified for Kirkuk.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official Ministry directory lists Kirkuk Real Estate Registration Directorates 1 and 2. A 2026 Ministry visit states that a land/property database was to be prepared. The Ministry’s electronic title/map service launch lists selected Baghdad offices and does not include Kirkuk. No public anonymous full-polygon viewer, vector service, or download was verified.

technicalBlocker: Official sources document the Kirkuk registry, but the land/property database is described as being prepared and no city parcel geometry endpoint is published. The Ministry’s electronic title/map workflow is not an anonymous parcel GIS and was not queried.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate municipality or survey-office viewer provides anonymous full parcel polygons; none was identified in the official sources inspected. The new land-property database’s deployment status and spatial data access remain unknown.
